extraction.Name: James Deroin
extraction.Recorded patent: Filed for record; receipted for by allottee
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to Mr. Hansen of Perry, Oklahoma, for $3000
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Mr. Hansen of Perry, Oklahoma, for $3000; foreclosed and redemption expired
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Mortgaged for $3000 and foreclosed which was about one-half of its value
extraction.Occupation/Income: Income of $10% from inherited land. No contributions from any source.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at Otoe Agency; accepted with protest in 1918. Land was worth $6000.00 per allottee's statement; mortgage of $3000 foreclosed, redemption expired. No land sold for debt or taxes. Wife and five minor children dependent upon allottee. Allottee appears to have been prevented in some way from receiving full value for his land. Document notarized November 22, 1928, in Kay County, Oklahoma; commission expires Aug. 23rd 1931. Both witnesses of Ponca City, Oklahoma.
